name: command
title: Command palette
description: Searchable palette on cmdk. Bind it to Ctrl or Cmd K.
htmlExample:
<bef-command style="width:360px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px">
  <bef-command-input placeholder="Type a command"></bef-command-input>
  <bef-command-list>
    <bef-command-empty>No results.</bef-command-empty>
    <bef-command-group heading="Navigate">
      <bef-command-item><bef-home-icon></bef-home-icon> Home</bef-command-item>
      <bef-command-item><bef-users-icon></bef-users-icon> People</bef-command-item>
    </bef-command-group>
    <bef-command-group heading="Actions"><bef-command-item><bef-plus-icon></bef-plus-icon> New employee</bef-command-item></bef-command-group>
  </bef-command-list>
</bef-command>
